item.title: Daily Horoscope for March 05, 2026
item.description: Goodwill grows when we share our aims. With the life-giving Sun trining Jupiter, the Greater Benefic, at 12:13 pm EST, courage and generosity harmonize, making it easier to coordinate plans and support each other. The morning may feel more somber and reflective, yet by midday, the vibe smooths into something more cooperative and actionable. Later, the emotional Moon forms a tense square to Jupiter, so we should pace commitments, clarify expectations, and keep conversations balanced. Steady steps

item.title: Young man fatally shot in the Bronx, three suspects sought
item.description: Lamar Simmons, 19, was gunned down at E. 183rd St. and Hughes Ave. in Belmont around 2:06 p.m., according to law enforcement officials.

item.title: Trump death plot suspect says he went along with Iranian handler to protect family
item.description: Merchant told jurors he expected to be caught by the feds, but claimed if he hadn't gone along with the chilling scheme, it would have put his family in Iran in danger.

item.title: Stefon Diggs is being cut loose from the New England Patriots: report
item.description: Star wide receiver Stefon Diggs is being cut loose from the New England Patriots, according to ESPN. Diggs appeared to confirm that claim.

item.title: Courtney Love teases a Hole reunion tour
item.description: Hole bandmates Courtney Love and Melissa Auf der Maur are teasing a Hole reunion. Not everyone appears to be into the plan.

item.title: Chet Holmgren fills role of No. 2 option for Thunder in tight win over Knicks
item.description: Thunder star Chet Holmgren entered Madison Square Garden with a shooting touch, knocking down 6-of-8 three-pointers by halftime

item.title: Knicks miss 2 shots at the buzzer, fall to reigning champion OKC Thunder, 103-100
item.description: The Knicks came up short against the reigning champs in a 103-100 loss at Madison Square Garden on Wednesday, but they made it close — especially down the stretch.

item.title: Top NYC school officials step down, paving the way for Chancellor Samuels to pick a team
item.description: A news conference was scheduled for Thursday morning.

item.title: Mike Brown earns first Knicks technical foul, rips officiating after MVP no-call in loss to Thunder
item.description: Knicks head coach Mike Brown doubled down on the missed offensive foul call that left him berating an official in front of a raucous Madison Square Garden crowd.

item.title: Asking Eric: Parents worry about college-age son’s ‘junk’ diet
item.description: Dear Eric: Our son, who is in college, began losing his hair in high school. It could be genetic, but this does not run in the family. Although he is skinny, he eats terribly.
